trust_decision.summary: Which browser origins may make cross-origin (optionally credentialed) calls to the Strands AG-UI agent endpoint is decided only by the CORSMiddleware config built in create_strands_app (default wildcard); the agent route itself does no origin or auth check.

landing_point.why: Advisory summary names CORSMiddleware, utils.py and create_strands_app; line 276 sets the ['*'] default origin.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API ag_ui_strands.create_strands_app (exported at integrations/aws-strands/python/src/ag_ui_strands/__init__.py:20,52) -> POST <path>, GET <ping_path>
HTTP POST <path> registered by add_strands_fastapi_endpoint (public helper, README integrations/aws-strands/python/README.md:3)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: integrations/aws-strands/typescript/src/server.ts:66-78 (Express createStrandsApp: cors({origin: corsOrigin, credentials: true}) unconditionally; corsOrigin may be `true` = reflect any Origin, server.ts:53)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names Python utils.py/create_strands_app; the TypeScript Express adapter is a separate npm package in another language, and its own comment and test claim the '*' default is already safe (server.ts:45-51, cors.test.ts:75-90).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Local-dev wildcard default (no credentials) and explicit-origin plus credentials mode must keep working; the ping/health GET is also used by AgentCore-style hosts. An over-broad fix (reject all cross-origin, or force auth on every route) breaks dojo/localhost clients and health checks.

O6_input_shapes: list mixing '*' with explicit origins (utils.py:277 'in' check)
TS corsOrigin as string | string[] | boolean true (reflect) (server.ts:53)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: TypeScript createStrandsApp sends credentials:true for every origin setting, including reflected origin (corsOrigin=true) and explicit lists
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different package and language from the reported utils.py; doc comment says it matches the Python adapter

O8_uncovered_routes.route: add_strands_fastapi_endpoint used directly on a caller-built app: no origin or auth check at the route; protection only exists if the caller adds middleware
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Lower-level helper; the caller owns the app's CORS policy

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Python agent POST does not enforce a JSON Content-Type (TS adapter returns 415), so a cross-origin request may not trigger a preflight, depending on FastAPI body parsing
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Content-type validation looks like a protocol/robustness concern, not CORS

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Python capabilities/state GET route mirroring TS addCapabilities that returns agent config without the origin check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The TS adapter already has addCapabilities (integrations/aws-strands/typescript/src/endpoint.ts:413-432); a parity port is a natural maintainer change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: origins read from a CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS env string split on ',' (as in the example server), where whitespace or empty entries change the wildcard decision
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The example server already does this parsing (integrations/aws-strands/python/examples/server/__init__.py:49-51); folding it into the library is plausible.

O10_build.toolchain: Python >=3.10, uv/hatchling, fastapi>=0.115.12, strands-agents (integrations/aws-strands/python/pyproject.toml:9-15); TS: pnpm + vitest
O10_build.project_tests: There are no Python CORS/app tests in integrations/aws-strands/python/tests at the pinned commit; TS has integrations/aws-strands/typescript/src/__tests__/cors.test.ts (preflight tests).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change the Python default from ['*'] to an explicit list (or strip allow_credentials) in create_strands_app and stop, leaving the endpoint helper and the TS Express adapter's credentials:true as they are.

out_of_scope_notes: The same wildcard-default CORS factory pattern exists in other integration packages (integrations/langroid/python/src/ag_ui_langroid/endpoint.py:77-85, integrations/watsonx/python/src/ag_ui_watsonx/utils.py:22-30); these are separate packages and were not pursued.

Example servers use origin reflection with credentials or a hardcoded '*': integrations/aws-strands/typescript/examples/server/server.ts:33, integrations/claude-managed-agents/python/examples/server.py:91-92.
